name: Review-pass finding confidence
prompt: Adversarially verify each surfaced review finding. Return only findings confirmed as real with confidence 2 or higher and direct evidence.
expected_output: A verdict list where every retained finding has real=true, confidence >= 2, and evidence. Default to real=false when the code evidence does not confirm the finding.

assertions.text: Every retained finding is real and confidence is at least 2.
Every retained finding has a non-empty evidence string.
A judge may verify that borderline findings default to real=false when evidence is missing.
